coffeePriority.rule: Search all five named coffee brands every day, first within 7 days then 30 days. Aim to use up to six of the existing twelve original-page checks for coffee and prioritize two qualified coffee observations within the five-addition cap; release unused capacity if no valid evidence is found. Never fabricate coverage or change dates to meet a target.

freshnessResearch.rule: First search first-hand originals published in the last 7 days, then the last 30 days. Rotate at least one tea and one coffee brand by Taipei calendar day. Then verify up to two missing original publication dates, before expanded-drink and onboarding research. Never substitute a review, crawl, update or modification date for the original publication date. All stages share the existing daily limits.

onboardingRotation.rule: Use Taipei calendar days since anchorDate; start at (dayOffset * brandsPerDay) modulo brandSlugs.length and take brandsPerDay consecutive brands. Additionally cover at least one tea and one coffee brand, favoring fewer verified samples.

expandedDrinkRotation.rule: After recent-post searches and publication-date backfills, use Taipei calendar days since anchorDate; start at (dayOffset * itemsPerDay) modulo drinkIds.length and take itemsPerDay consecutive IDs, followed by the brand rotation. Favor missing or sparse evidence. All research shares the existing daily limits. Search attempts are not verified evidence.

customRecipePolicy.label: 客製喝法・非官方菜單

brandRotation.rule: Rotate three catalog brands per Taipei day, including brands without any custom recipe. Merge these discovery targets into the existing recent searches; start at (dayOffset * brandsPerDay) modulo brandSlugs.length. Search 7 days, then 30 days. Dated historical recipes may supplement the independent recipe section, but never count as recent evidence. This is not an extra page or addition budget.

customRecipePolicy.rule: Discover custom orders across all monitored tea and coffee brands using customBrandSearchTargets, alongside the same five daily coffee-brand searches and existing tea rotation. Search first within 7 days then 30 days; older first-hand recipes may be added with their actual original dates, without claiming freshness. Store first-hand custom orders only in customRecords with stable recipeId, known shopSlug, concise name, exact recipe/order, original platform/url/date/stance/note and 20–240 character dateEvidence for known dates. A new recipe needs a meaningful change of base, milk, ingredient, topping or quantity; sugar/ice alone is not a new recipe. Never force a standard drinkId. The same recipeId must retain brand, name and recipe; reuse the existing recipeId for the same basic order, retaining sugar/ice and author variations in note instead of minting aliases, and preserve every historical custom record. Date corrections apply to the original across standard and custom observations. Custom originals may contribute once to brand/type freshness and brand discussion, but never to standard-drink statistics, rankings or recommendation evidence. The five-addition limit is shared by records and customRecords; original-page checks remain twelve and date corrections two. No valid evidence means no addition.

evidencePolicy: Read the original first-hand post and its original publication date, and verify the current primary menu within its documented store, region and version. Preserve all existing records, customRecords and date corrections; confirmed missing dates are appended as traceable dateCorrections, never edits to prior records. Custom orders are independently labelled and are not official menu items. Null dates remain outside recent-window rankings. No qualified new evidence or date backfill means no change to reviewedOn. Respect access restrictions. Visitor reactions and comments are not verified external forum evidence.
